daily.title: West Asia conflict has generated a relatively stronger oil price shock, larger rupee depreciation, surge in price of gold: RBI Study
daily.summary: RBI study shows West Asia conflict triggers stronger oil price shocks, rupee depreciation, and surging gold prices, broadening imported inflation versus the Russia-Ukraine episode. Consequently, inflationary pressures arising from the current episode are broader and more intense than those observed during the Russia-Ukraine conflict. The study “Shifting Drivers of Imported Inflation: COVID-19 Pandemic to the West Asia Conflict”, published in the latest RBI monthly bulletin, noted that both Russia-Ukraine conflict and West Asia conflict episodes resulted in Brent prices reaching a comparable level of around $110 per barrel in March-May quarter in 2022 as well as 2026.

daily.title: Repeated Non-Compliance After Remand May Bar Further Hearing: ITAT Delhi
daily.summary: ITAT Delhi refuses another remand after repeated non-compliance, sustains ₹9.43 lakh addition and rejects the Section 143(2) notice-format objection. Summary: The Delhi ITAT declined to grant another opportunity to an assessee who had obtained a remand on the ground of inadequate hearing but had then ignored three hearing notices issued by the CIT(A) . The Tribunal treated it as a rare case in which the assessee had exhausted the opportunities available to present his case. It dismissed the appeal, leaving the ₹9,43,033 addition under Section 68 undisturbed.

daily.title: Agricultural Land’s Municipal Distance Must Be Verified Before Taxing Capital Gains: ITAT Delhi
daily.summary: The case concerned the taxability of gains from the sale of land for AY 2011–12. In the first round, the Tribunal had restored the matter to the Assessing Officer to determine whether the land qualified as agricultural land for the purpose in dispute. The specific inquiry concerned the distance of the property from the municipal limits. On remand, the Assessing Officer issued a notice to the Tehsildar, Sadar, Dehradun, and obtained information from the Municipal Corporation of Dehradun. The Corporation stated that the land was situated within eight kilometres of the municipal limits.

daily.title: Capital Gains on POA Sale Require Verification of Actual Ownership: ITAT Delhi
daily.summary: ITAT Delhi remands ₹2.61 crore capital gains addition and issues a conditional Section 150(1) direction to assess the wife if ownership is established. Summary: The Delhi ITAT restored an addition of ₹2,61,50,000 for fresh assessment after the assessee claimed that he had executed two sale deeds only as his wife’s power-of-attorney holder and that his PAN had been entered in the deeds by mistake. The Tribunal found that the ownership claim required documentary verification. It also issued a conditional direction under Section 150(1) to initiate proceedings in the wife’s case if the evidence established that she owned the properties.

daily.title: Senior Citizen Tax Rates For Tax Year 2026-27: With Example on Different Income Levels
daily.summary: Senior citizens in India can pay tax under two systems: the New Regime and the Old Regime.For Tax Year 2026–27, the New Regime has the same slabs for ever This guide compares the two in simple steps, so you can pick the one that saves you more tax. Tax Year 2026–27 is the same period as FY 2026–27 (AY 2027–28) under the older terminology. Tax is progressive, so each rate applies only to the income inside its band. A 4% Health and Education Cess is added on top, and a surcharge applies at higher incomes.
